behavior.authorization: Latest explicit request resumes the feature previously disabled on 2026-10-30.
behavior.entry: 로비 → 전체 메뉴 → 클랜 → 내 클랜 → 방출
behavior.allowed: Current active elder may remove an ordinary member of the same current clan.
protected: non-elder actors, including OWNER without elder membership
active battle, settlement and reserved defense restrictions
atomicEffects: both faction formations and captain/empty-defense cleanup
behavior.retry: Successful replay does not remove a member who later rejoins; a new request with the stale membership timestamp is rejected.

implementation.policy: Enable the existing shared policy; retain existing server authorization and transactional removal.
implementation.dialog: Position the native confirmation inside the visible parent game viewport, including the command header, because an auto-height iframe otherwise centers the buttons offscreen.
implementation.renderWork: Coalesce scroll/resize into one animation frame, avoid unchanged style writes, and disconnect all new listeners/observer and cancel pending frame on close/pagehide.
implementation.cache: Version the organization document/module import chain with 20261118-elder-kick.

cases: actual organization and legacy clan routes
injected audit and receipt failures roll back
rejoin followed by old receipt and stale request
current admission and voluntary leave cooldown
verification.browser: Five actual lobby entry paths with isolated PGlite APIs, cancel without POST, confirm once, both rosters removed once, listener counts restored, then exit with zero requests.

limitations: Before frame sampling covers the roster because removal is disabled; after sampling additionally covers opening, cancelling and confirming. These frame workloads are not equivalent.
WebKit retains its existing ResizeObserver warning; enabled-action sampling recorded one 295 ms long frame. This is recorded, not claimed fixed.
Desktop before/after was repeated after the test process had finished to avoid test CPU contention.
Loading samples include local process/browser/cache variation; Windows and H5 observations are emulated entry paths.

qaNotes: Initial new-season test failed because its admission-only fixture lacked clan_faction_state. A dedicated kick fixture adds the isolated table; the final release gate passes all 32 tests.
Initial UI confirmation placed its controls below the parent viewport. The scoped dialog positioning fix was then verified across the five platforms.
The old OFF regression assertions were replaced with the previously reviewed ON suites and current-season coverage. Historical OFF records remain preserved.
